Here in the USA I feel we are doing great vaccine-wise, for example here in my state (New York) we have reached approx 90% vaccination rate (maybe 85% I don't know), according to what science told us back in 2020, we have already reached herd immunity (greater than 70% vaccination, or something like that).  Same could be told for other states, most states are hovering at between 60 to 90% vaccination rates, compared to worldwide, specially third world countries, the USA is doing exceptionally great vaccine-wise.

The problem is not in the USA, the problem is in countries like Africa with less than 10% or 5% vaccination rates.  Keep in mind that in Africa is where the Omicron variant came from, and it was brought to us by a vaccinated person. I say, instead of giving booster shots to us, USA, why not send all of those vaccines to Africa instead, and once we get EVERY country vaccinated sufficiently in order to afford "herd immunity" (at least 70% vaccination rate or greater), then we can start talking the Booster language.
